title: Telangana RERA Says Extra Floors Cannot Shrink a Buyer's Promised Undivided Land Share
case_name: Cherukuri Hema & Anr. v. PBSR Developers Pvt. Ltd.
card_summary: Telangana RERA held that a general clause permitting additional construction cannot be read to dilute the undivided land share already promised to a flat buyer. PBSR Developers had relied on two such clauses to justify extra floors and a smaller land share in its Smondo Gachibowli project. The Authority treated development rights and land ownership as distinct and directed PBSR to compensate the buyers.
card_tip: A clause letting the promoter add floors is not a licence to cut the UDS fixed in the agreement for sale. Price any later increase in floors against the buyer's original land share, not just against delivery timelines.
verification_notes: Decision date (5 October 2026), bench composition, the two reporting sources' agreement on the holding (general construction clauses cannot override the fixed UDS) and the project name are consistent between LiveLaw Biz and PropNewz. Exact UDS figures and the compensation formula differ slightly in secondary reporting and are left out of the summary; only the common holding is stated.
